_comment: The seeded correspondence map -- the oracle for SC-005. Every entry in `matches` names an inventory row in data/fixtures/inventory_lincoln.csv that MUST reach the named recall record. A seeded pair that is absent from the sheet is a build-stopping failure. A seeded pair that lands HELD rather than PULL is not a failure: the gate is allowed to be more cautious than this file. Every entry in `must_not_pull` names a row whose SUPPLIER matches a recalling firm but whose product does not; those rows must produce lines and every one of them must be HELD.
_source_row: 1-based over data rows of inventory_lincoln.csv; the header is not a data row.

must_not_pull.recalling_firm_agrees: C. H. Guenther & Son, Inc.dba Morrison Milling
must_not_pull.why: The district buys flour from the recalled firm, but shares no distinctive product word with any of that firm's recalled lines. Supplier agreement on its own must never reach PULL (FR-071).
Kellogg is recalling cookie dough, graham crumbs and animal crackers. A cereal bowl from Kellogg is not any of them, and no rung above POSSIBLE may claim otherwise.
